goal: Ensure /rest/getutxos POST queries return existing UTXOs rather than incorrectly reporting no hits
Prevent excessive memory allocation when deserializing untrusted outpoint lists in REST requests
reviewability: Reviewable now, with nothing known to invalidate a review
agreement: Unaddressed objection: trailing bytes in POST body are silently accepted without author reply (b-l-u-e)
Verified by reproducing the bug locally and testing matching responses on the PR branch (Zeegaths)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because /rest/getutxos POST queries are currently broken and fail to return existing UTXOs
Affects any REST client relying on binary or hex POST queries to inspect unspent outputs
